title: Hamiltonicity of mildly pseudorandom regular graphs
summary: We show that if an $(n,d,λ)$-graph satisfies $λ\leq (1-δ)d$ and $d\gg δ^{-6}(\log n)^{3}$ for some $δ>0$, then it is Hamiltonian. A qualitatively similar result was recently proven by Bradač and Janzer. Our proof here is shorter and gives better quantitative bounds. \par In our proof, as in earlier work of Ferber, Han, Mao, and Vershynin, we use a random matrix inequality to show that a mild spectral gap is typically preserved after randomly sampling an appropriate proportion of the vertices.
